judgment_calls.decision: The emergency patient is not a recorded complaint, so the task fires on an or of the page entry points: Unresponsive, Cardiac arrest, Respiratory obstruction, Dyspnea, and the vital thresholds the page acts on (SBP < 80, pulse < 50 or ≥ 100, RR < 9 or > 30, SpO2 < 94%).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Trigger on Unresponsive only (misses conscious patients with tension pneumothorax/shock); split into several tasks.

judgment_calls.decision: Emergency for both priority rules: the page is "The emergency patient" and involves CPR and airway management.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Urgent, from the header wording "Give urgent attention".

judgment_calls.topic: Which ABC conditions become Emergency criteria
judgment_calls.decision: Every condition the page acts on with resuscitation is included (airway obstruction signs, SpO2 < 94%, RR < 9, blue lips/tongue, tension pneumothorax, pulse < 50 with instability, shock/SBP < 80, pulse ≥ 100, heavy bleeding, GCS ≤ 8). "Difficulty breathing" alone is left out: it only triggers oxygen and, because Dyspnea is a descendant of Difficulty breathing, it would make every patient recording dyspnoea an Emergency.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Include difficulty breathing too; or leave all ABC "If" conditions as management only.

judgment_calls.decision: Any-of: shock, SBP < 80, pulse ≥ 100, heavy bleeding, each alone.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Pulse ≥ 100 qualifying SBP < 80 (and), which would fire less often.

judgment_calls.decision: Probable shock needs all of SBP < 80, pulse ≥ 100, RR > 30, confusion or restlessness, and weakness.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Any-of (pulse ≥ 100 alone would mean shock likely); any2 would be invented.

judgment_calls.decision: Sudden-onset dyspnoea AND (hyperresonance, decreased breath sounds or chest pain, each Unilateral) AND trachea displaced.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Any-of the features; Unilateral on chest pain only.

judgment_calls.decision: Enumerated as the six SNOMED findings Glasgow coma scale, 3 … 8.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Leave as not_representable (no unit for a GCS measurement).
